name: Dissolution of the Silent Union
source: Dissolution of the Silent Union is a short, narrative-driven visual novel where you accompany Vera, who is trapped on the last day of school, toward her inevitable date.
translation: 《Dissolution of the Silent Union》是一部側重敘事的短篇視覺小說。薇拉被困在上學的最後一天，你將陪她走向那場無法迴避的約會。
